about.en: Walmart rToken (rWMT) is a tokenized share of Walmart, issued by Reality, Bitget's real-world asset issuance platform. Each token is backed 1:1 by WMT held through Alpaca Securities, a FINRA-registered US broker-dealer, with daily proof-of-reserves attestations, and trades as an ERC-20 on Arbitrum. rTokens are offered only to eligible non-US persons in permitted jurisdictions.
